☁️ Google Drive Private Cloud Backup & Restore (v1.1.4) by Dhiraj:
• ☁️ Google Drive Cloud Backup: Securely back up your entire encrypted message history directly to your personal Google Drive account
• 📥 Google Drive Cloud Restore: 1-Tap restore from your Google Drive backup on any new or existing Android device
• 🔒 Zero-Knowledge Cryptography: Messages are encrypted on-device with AES-256-GCM before uploading to Google Drive—neither Google nor third parties can decrypt your data
• 📊 Cloud Status Dashboard: Live tracking of your last Google Drive backup date, time, and backed up message count
